### Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Follow-up approach | Follow-up implementation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: > 70% enzyme activity** | PQ 1 mg/kg/day over 7 days or TQ | Partially implemented | Monitor side effects by basic health staff in coverage area of health facility recheck Day1,3,5, & 7 |  |
| **G6PD normal: > 30% enzyme activity** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Partially implemented | Monitor side effects by basic health staff in coverage area of health facility recheck Day1,3,5, & 7 | Implemented |
| **G6PD deficient: < 30% enzyme activity** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Partially implemented |  |  |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Partially implemented | Monitor side effects by basic health staff in coverage area of health facility recheck Day1,3,5,7 & 10 |  |
